# Vercel

Vercel is a platform for frontend frameworks and static sites, enabling developers to host websites and web services that deploy instantly, scale automatically, and require minimal configuration.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vercel/.

## Actions

- **Add Environment Variable**: Add an environment variable to a vercel project.
- **Check Cache Artifact Exists**: Check if a cache artifact exists by its hash.
- **Check Domain Availability**: Check if a domain is available for registration.
- **Check Domain Price**: Check the price for a domain before purchase.
- **Create Auth Token**: Create a new authentication token.
- **Create Edge Config**: Create a new edge config for a vercel project.
- **Create new deployment**: Create a new deployment.
- **Delete Auth Token**: Delete an authentication token.
- **Delete Deployment**: Delete a specific deployment by its unique id.
- **Delete Environment Variable**: Delete a specific environment variable from a project.
- **Delete Vercel Project**: Delete a specific project by its id or name.
- **Deploy Edge Function**: Deploy edge functions to vercel.
- **Get deployment details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific deployment.
- **Get Deployment Events** (read-only): Retrieve events related to a specific deployment.
- **Get Deployment Logs** (read-only): Retrieve logs for a specific vercel deployment.
- **Get Domain Transfer Info**: Get information required to transfer a domain to vercel.
- **Get Edge Config** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific edge config.
- **Get Edge Config Item** (read-only): Retrieve a specific item within an edge config.
- **Get Vercel Project**: Retrieve information about a vercel project by id or name.
- **List All Deployments** (read-only): List all deployments.
- **List Auth Tokens** (read-only): List authentication tokens.
- **List Deployment Checks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of checks for a specific deployment.
- **List Edge Configs** (read-only): List all edge configs.
- **List Environment Variables**: List environment variables for a specific project.
- **List Vercel Aliases**: List all aliases for the authenticated user or team.
- **Update Edge Config Items**: Update items within a specific edge config.
- **Update Vercel Project**: Update an existing project.
- **Create Edge Config Token**: Create a new token for a specific edge config.
- **Delete Edge Config Tokens**: Delete tokens associated with a specific edge config.
- **Get Auth Token Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata for an authentication token.
- **Get Edge Config Token** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific token associated with an edge config.
- **List All Teams** (read-only): List all teams accessible to the authenticated user.
- **List Edge Config Items** (read-only): Retrieve a list of items within a specific edge config.
- **List Edge Config Tokens** (read-only): Retrieve a list of tokens for a specific edge config.
- **Update Edge Config**: Update an existing edge config.
